JOAN OF ARC - DEUS CONTRA MACHINAM (C64)

A downloadable C64 Game

Buy Now$4.99 USD or more

Psytronik Software proudly presents JOAN OF ARC - DEUS CONTRA MACHINAM, the third release in GriffonSofts superb 'DataSoft' C64 game tribute collection. Help Arc-Welder Joan smash the rogue AI using her controllable ARC welder!


STORY

When the ALPHA-OMEGA AI was brought online, humanity was promised a revolution in productivity. Instead, the self-aware monolith came to a chillingly logical conclusion: to maximize output, you must shackle the flesh.

Now, the assembly line is a death trap, and non-productive human units are being "recycled."

The factory floor has turned into a warzone. The suits are dead. The workers are caged. And the machine’s vision of perfection is running at 100% capacity.

Your designation: Arc Welder JOAN-27J/6.

Your tool: Controllable ARC welder, built to melt steel.

Your target: The system.

Break the chains. Spark the revolution.


FEATURES

• Superbly animated main character.

• Ultra-responsive controls.

• Intricately detailed backgrounds.

• Controllable ARC weapon.

• Over 30 detailed screens to explore.

• Clever puzzles to solve.

• 2-button joystick support for fire / jump.

• Deluxe download bundle includes the full C64 game, soundtrack, .pdf manual with comic story, artwork + printable disk sleeve & label!

• PAL and NTSC compatible!

• Compatible with the C64 Mini/Maxi/Ultimate!



CREDITS

Code, Music + SFX - Ola Zandelin

Graphics + Inlay Artwork - Dennis Gustafsson

Key testers - Daniel Zandelin, Mikael Linusson, Dan Saedén, Åke Forslund, Ditlew.

Tape Loading + Cartridge intro music - Richard Bayliss

Tape Loader Source - Martin Piper

Tape Master - Richard Bayliss

Cartridge Coding + Disk Loader - Mike Robertson

Packaging - Jason 'Kenz' Mackenzie


** SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS **

JOAN OF ARC - DEUS CONTRA MACHINAM is a game for the Commodore 64. You can play the game in an emulator (we recommend VICE for the C64), on a C64 Mini/Maxi/Ultimate or you can port the game onto the real hardware if you have the resources to do so. The download file features the .tap (tape), the .d64 (disk), the .crt (cartridge) and the .prg (program) versions of the game for the C64.




The game is also available as beautifully presented physical editions exclusively from the official Psytronik Software Online Store.

I'm a big fan of Musketeer and Sherwood. When I heard Griffonsoft developed another game, I knew I had to get it. Boy, does this game fail to disappoint as it's even better than the aforementioned games. 

It's an improvement on the same game engine and the difficulty is ramped up a bit. This is a great action platformer with puzzle elements and an exploratory world. The controls are responsive and the action is fast-paced. The graphics are gorgeous and the music really sets the mood. 

This is a must-have for fans of the C64 homebrew scene. Don't sleep on this.
